constraints: listLevelCount is only meaningful when styleSheetType is wk type paragraph; if specified (value >= 1) the command creates a hierarchical list style sheet with the specified number of levels (a root-level style sheet plus sub-level style sheets).
If listLevelCount is omitted or 0, a standard (non-list) paragraph style sheet is created.

styleSheetName must start with a letter, may then contain alphanumeric/space/'-'/unicode (>=128) characters, must be unique in the document across both style sheet types, and must not start with 'section' (reserved).
